notes.title: THE SCREEN (Playtest) - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[Add] Added the option to reduce flashing effects in the game menu. The option is also presented to the player at the beginning of the game.

The following contains spoilers:

[Fix] [spoiler]Fixed the bug that caused the player to be able to move when examing items[/spoiler].

[Fix] (Hotfix) [spoiler]Temporarily disabled the ability to exam items when the elevator is descending[/spoiler].



If you encounter any issues after the update, feel free to contact through the bug report Google Form.
